config.productSummary: Autonomous real-time multi-agent arbitration engine with sub-200ms voice barge-in and deterministic turn bidding.
config.targetCustomer: FinTech, Healthcare, and High-Frequency Enterprise Boards
config.businessModel: Tiered Enterprise SLA + Usage-based Compute Pass-Through

patterns.rule: LTV to CAC Ratio & Payback Period Consistency
incisiveQuestions: What is your net customer acquisition cost after amortizing direct sales salaries and model token consumption?
How does your payback timeline shift if enterprise procurement cycles drag past 90 days?
What is your gross margin profile once dedicated edge inference compute is factored in?

patterns.rule: Burn Velocity vs. Runway Under Stress
patterns.benchmarkMetric: Minimum 18 months runway at target post-money valuation
incisiveQuestions: How many months of runway does this capital allocation provide under zero enterprise renewal assumptions?
What is your monthly net burn rate including hosting overhead and model training runs?

patterns.rule: Inference SLA & Edge Latency Hard Boundaries
incisiveQuestions: What is your P99 round-trip latency when upstream foundation model inference degrades?
Are you running self-hosted quantized checkpoints on bare-metal or proxying raw API tokens?
What is your exact mitigation for token rate-limit saturation under concurrent multi-user load?
Why can a foundation model provider not deploy this multi-agent arbitration heuristic as a default feature in their SDK?
Where is your proprietary data flywheel located, and who owns the customer interaction embeddings?

patterns.benchmarkMetric: ACV > $25k or viral bottom-up developer motion
incisiveQuestions: What is your proprietary wedge against Microsoft, Google, and Salesforce entering this boardroom decision market?
Walk this committee through your first 10 closed-won enterprise contracts and their expansion velocity.
